Name: AT Pet Guinea Pig
Author: EnbyFelix
Description:
Alternative Textures pack for the cat to change it into a pet guinea pig or hamster (or whatever you think it looks like). Art credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/94376493]Kanafile[/url], ty for letting me use your sprites!

There are three textures so far, two are from Kanafile's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8304]Hamsters[/url] mod. The black/gray one is my retexture.

To turn your cat into a guinea pig/hamster, buy the scissors from Robin and use them on the cat.
